movie.name: Hope (South Korea, 2026)
movie.synopsis: In the remote South Korea village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok (Hwang Jung- min) and officer Sung-ae (Hoyeon) are called to find a mysterious creature that has wreaked havoc on the village. In the nearby forest, a coterie of hunters, including Sung- ki (Zo In-Sung) set out to track the beast and find themselves hunted instead. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

movie.name: American Doctor
movie.synopsis:
When three American doctors — Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian — enter Gaza to save lives, they find themselves caught between medicine and politics, risking everything to expose the truth. 

There will be a community conversation with HEAL Palestine following the 4:35pm show on Sunday 9/6, and a community conversation with Alice Rothchild, MD following the 7:40 show on Tuesday 9/8.

movie.name: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
movie.synopsis: SHAUN THE SHEEP: THE BEAST OF MOSSY BOTTOM sees the residents of Mossy Bottom Farm looking forward to Halloween -- until the clumsy Farmer trashes the flock's beloved pumpkin patch! When Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control... With the Farmer missing and a wild beast roaming the woods of Mossingham, all the ingredients are in place for a monstrously fun family adventure!

movie.name: Seattle Film Society Presents Locals Only
movie.synopsis:
LOCALS ONLY is a monthly screening of short films featuring Washington State independent filmmakers. Curated by the SFS Programming Team, screenings include in-depth Q&A’s with the filmmakers as well as the opportunity to engage with the Seattle community.

In honor of back to school month, September’s event is a Student Showcase! From Satire to Sci Fi, Fantasy to Documentary, these four shorts focus on the exciting work being made by the next generation of local filmmakers: 
  • LABYRINTH by Brandon Mattesich: When she wakes up in the forest, the forest wakes up around her. Join her as she tries to find a way out. (3 min) 
  • STELLANS by Kai Monear: In a future world dominated by an advanced species known as machina stellans must escape their sprawling campus. (10 min) 
  • a small city called Taishan by Jordan Wu: A person that lived in the states for his entire life returns to his family’s hometown, searching for whether his hometown feels like a foreign place or home. (15 min) 
  • EXTRA BUTTER by T.C. Sheahan: A contemptuous moviegoer is determined to get enough butter on their popcorn. (3 min) 
This event is presented in partnership with the Tasveer Film Center. Join us for a screening and Q&A with drinks to follow at Flying Lion Brewing! See ya at the movies!

movie.name: No Country for Mothers, Family Friendly Screening & Community Conversation
movie.synopsis:
No Country for Mothers explores the culture wars surrounding American motherhood and why both the “girl boss” and “trad wife” labels ultimately distract us from the real issue: the lack of support for American families. Following activist Reshma Saujani, the film charts a growing national movement to reunite moms across divisions and win the kind of historic support families actually need.

Join us for this family-friendly screening and community event with an age appropriate Q&A, games and activities for kids, and free Molly Moon's Homemade Ice Cream. This isn't just about watching a film; it's about being in a room where we can say things out loud that we've been carrying quietly, and realize we are not alone. We would love for you to join us.
